functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, created_at)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', NEW.email),
    'student',
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()

CREATE TRIGGER leads_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.leads FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
